info.title: Rolla Developer API
info.description: API for programmatic transaction management on the Rolla platform. Monetary `amount` fields use the smallest unit of the referenced currency unless an endpoint says otherwise (e.g. NGN = kobo, USD = cents, where **100 cents = USD 1.00**).

post.description: Creates (or returns the existing) permanent NGN virtual account dedicated to one of your end-users, so deposits to it can be attributed to that user via webhook. The provider requires the end-user's BVN, name and date of birth. Idempotent per customer_identifier: re-requesting for the same customer returns the account already on file (HTTP 200) rather than creating a duplicate.

customer_identifier.description: Your own unique id for this end-user. Pass it so the account maps back to the user and re-requests are idempotent. If omitted, one is generated and returned.

bvn.description: End-user's 11-digit Bank Verification Number. Validated by the provider. Never returned in responses.

date_of_birth.description: End-user's date of birth in mm/dd/yyyy format.

bvn_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the BVN. The full BVN is never returned.

existing.description: true when an account already existed for this customer_identifier and was returned unchanged (idempotent); false when newly created.

200.description: An account already existed for this customer_identifier and was returned unchanged

message.example: Customer virtual account already exists for this customer_identifier

post.description: Sandbox only: inject a deposit into one of your own virtual accounts. The wallet is credited and the deposit webhook is delivered, without a real bank transfer. Returns 404 in production. Provide exactly one of customer_identifier or account_number.

customer_identifier.description: Customer id of one of your customer virtual accounts. Provide this or account_number, not both.

account_number.description: Account number of any of your virtual accounts. Provide this or customer_identifier, not both.

amount.description: Deposit amount in major units of the account currency (e.g. Naira). Must exceed the account pay-in fee.

sender_name.description: Name to record as the sender on the transaction.

provider.description: Force the provider tag on the deposit. Omit to inherit the target account's own provider.

post.description: Sandbox only: simulate an incoming USD deposit into your account's USD wallet. Dispatched to the account's USD provider sandbox; the wallet is credited asynchronously via the provider's deposit webhook. Returns 404 in production. Requires an issued, active USD account.

parameters.name: X-Account-Id
parameters.description: Target a specific sub-account under your tenancy. Omit to use the calling account.

amount.description: Deposit amount in major units of USD. Must be greater than 0.

reference.description: Your own reference for the simulated transfer. Auto-generated if omitted.

sender_name.description: Name to record as the sender/counterparty on the transaction.

data.message: Simulated incoming USD transfer submitted. The balance will be credited to the wallet via the provider webhook.

404.description: No USD account provisioned (USD_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND), or endpoint called in production.

post.description: Generates a hosted identity verification link for an INDIVIDUAL account (the individual-flow parallel of the related-person KYC link). Share the returned URL with the account holder — it opens a Rolla-hosted page where they upload an ID and complete a liveness check. Only valid for individual accounts; calling it on a business account returns 400. Generating a new link invalidates the previous one. Links expire after 72 hours.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Identifier of an individual account owned by the same user as your API key's business

url.description: Hosted verification page to share with the account holder. Links expire after 72 hours.

400.description: Not an individual account (use the related-person KYC link for business owners/directors)

401.description: Invalid or missing API key

source_amount.description: Amount debited from the source wallet

destination_amount.description: Amount credited to the destination wallet

rateToken.description: Token to lock in this rate for a swap

toCurrency.description: Destination currency code (must differ from fromCurrency)

fromAmount.description: Amount to swap from source currency

rateToken.description: Rate token from /wallet/rates to lock in a specific rate

amount.description: Amount in smallest units (kobo for NGN; US cents for USD — 100 = 1 USD).

externalReference.description: Your own unique reference for this transaction

beneficiaryId.description: ID of a saved beneficiary. Use this OR inlineBeneficiary.

inlineBeneficiary.description: One-time beneficiary details (use instead of beneficiaryId)

saveBeneficiary.description: Save the inline beneficiary for future use

deductFeesFromBalance.description: If true, fees are taken from your wallet balance so the beneficiary receives the exact amount

InlineBeneficiary.description: One-time beneficiary details (use instead of beneficiaryId). Required fields depend on currency and withdrawal_method — see the endpoint docs for per-currency examples.

withdrawal_method.description: Required for USD, GBP, EUR, and crypto. NGN defaults to local transfer.

account_name.description: Account holder name. Required for all currencies except EUR SEPA. For crypto, used as a display nickname.

account_number.description: Required for NGN, USD, GBP local (8 digits), GBP international, EUR international. Not required for EUR SEPA or crypto.

bank_name.description: Required for NGN, USD, GBP. Not required for EUR SEPA or crypto.

bank_code.description: Required for NGN (e.g. '000014' for Access Bank).

swift_code.description: Required for USD international_wire, GBP international_wire, EUR international_wire, and other currencies.

sort_code.description: Required for GBP local_transfer. Must be exactly 6 digits.

bank_address.description: Required for USD, GBP (international), EUR (international), and XAF/other currencies.

beneficiary_address.description: Required for USD and GBP. Street, city, state, postalCode, and country.

wallet_address.description: Required for crypto_usdt and crypto_usdc. Must be 26–64 alphanumeric characters. Use with currency: USD.

wallet_chain.description: Required for crypto_usdt and crypto_usdc. The blockchain network (e.g. 'ethereum', 'tron'). Use with currency: USD.

intermediary_bank_name.description: Optional. Intermediary bank for USD international_wire.

intermediary_bank_routing_number.description: Optional. Intermediary bank routing number for USD international_wire.

contact_person.description: Optional. Contact person at the beneficiary.

loanAccountId.description: ID of the loan account to draw from

destinationWalletId.description: ID of the wallet to receive funds

loanAccountId.description: ID of the loan account to repay

sourceWalletId.description: ID of the wallet to pay from

recipient_business_id.description: Required for rolla_transfer. The UUID of the destination Rolla business.

account_owner_type.description: Whether the account is held by an individual or a business. Present for bank-account beneficiaries; null on legacy records that predate this field.

account_category.description: Whether a USD account is checking or savings. Present for USD beneficiaries; null on legacy records that predate this field.

bank_address.description: Bank's physical address. Required for USD domestic and international wire transfers.

beneficiary_address.description: Beneficiary's physical address. Required for USD domestic and international wire transfers.

recipient_business_id.description: Required for rolla_transfer. The UUID of the destination Rolla business.

account_owner_type.description: Whether the account is held by an individual or a business. Required for every bank-account beneficiary (any fiat method that is not crypto or rolla_transfer, including NGN bank transfer, domestic_wire, and international_wire). Not applicable to crypto_usdt, crypto_usdc, or rolla_transfer. During the deprecation grace period, requests that omit this field still succeed but return a `deprecation_warning` object; after the enforcement date the request is rejected with a 400. See the Beneficiary Account Fields migration guide.

account_category.description: Whether a USD account is checking or savings. Required only when `currency` is USD. If you are not sure, use "checking". Subject to the same grace-period behaviour as account_owner_type.

name.description: Role name. `business_owner` and `individual_owner` are reserved and never returned by this endpoint.

permissions.description: List of permissions granted by this role

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

fullname.description: Full name of the person to invite

roleId.description: Role to assign (from /teams/roles). Optional — defaults to the initiator role when omitted.

role.description: Assigned role name. The former `collaborator` value is now returned as `initiator`.

role_id.description: UUID of the role to assign. Retrieve available roles from `GET /teams/roles`.

status.description: New status for the team member

line2.description: Secondary address line (apt/suite). Used by USD account issuance; derived from city/state when omitted.

email.description: Owner's email (shared across all of the owner's accounts)

name.description: Business name. Required when type is `business`.

firstName.description: Account holder first name (individual accounts). Defaults to the owner's name.

lastName.description: Account holder last name (individual accounts). Defaults to the owner's name.

email.description: The account's own contact email. REQUIRED, and must be unique among your accounts — every account you onboard is a distinct customer with its own email. A duplicate (same owner) returns 409 with code ACCOUNT_EMAIL_EXISTS; omitting it returns 400.

IndividualInfo.description: Personal, address and employment details for an individual account. All fields are optional per request; provided fields are merged into the stored application.

idDocument.description: Identity document, consumed by USD account issuance. A verified Sumsub document overrides it when present.

readyToSubmit.description: True when all required fields and documents are present

relatedPersons.description: Business accounts only: KYC verification state of each related person

identityVerification.description: Individual accounts only: identity (ID + liveness) verification state

url.description: Hosted verification page to share with the person. Links expire after 72 hours.

accountData.description: Optional overrides merged over the details prefilled from the account's application. The shape depends on the provider — call GET /accounts/{accountId}/bank-accounts/requirements to see the prefilled payload and what's missing. For USD, entries in `representatives` merge into the prefilled person matching the same `relatedPersonId`.
